caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, circular textile or embroidery sample placed on a plain, light beige background. The main circle is bordered with a red color. Inside the red border, there is a decorative pattern consisting of abstract, leaf-like or vine-like grayish shapes arranged along the inner circumference. The central feature is a diamond shape which is oriented so that its corners touch the edges of the circle. This diamond is comprised of four concentrically arranged diamonds. The innermost diamond is black, followed by a dark brown diamond, which is surrounded by a light brown diamond, and finally an outer reddish-brown diamond. Each diamond is slightly larger than the one inside it, and together they form a step-like layered effect in the center of the circle. The pattern appears textured, resembling woven fabric, and shows evidence of wear around the edges. There is a faint handwritten note just below the lower edge of the circle on the plain background.
title: Needlework
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
